recognize_zh: 這是基因表現熱圖配合 Kaplan-Meier 曲線的非形態學圖表：復發 DLBCL 依基因預測分為 GC 與 ABC 型，在 R-DHAP 組 GC 型的 PFS 明顯優於 ABC 型（p = 0.01，OS p = 0.06），而 R-ICE 組兩者無顯著差異。
features: Gene expression heat maps (red/green) on the left used for GC versus ABC cell-of-origin classification
Four Kaplan-Meier plots: PFS (top) and OS (bottom) for R-ICE (left) and R-DHAP (right)
R-ICE: no significant difference between GC and ABC for PFS or OS (p = NS)
R-DHAP: GC curves plateau near the top while ABC curves drop, PFS p = 0.01 and OS p = 0.06
Small subgroup sizes (GCB profile n = 19 per caption) with stepwise curves
describe_en: This non-morphologic figure pairs gene expression profiling heat maps with Kaplan-Meier progression-free and overall survival curves from relapsed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma treated with R-ICE or R-DHAP salvage in the CORAL study. Among patients treated with R-DHAP, those with a germinal center (GC) profile had significantly better progression-free survival than those with an activated B-cell (ABC) profile (p = 0.01), with a trend for overall survival (p = 0.06), whereas no significant difference was seen with R-ICE. The interpretation is hypothesis-generating, given the small subgroups, suggesting that cell of origin may influence response to specific salvage regimens.
